does: Gives the average damage a character deals, as the AI estimates it, memoised per entity in the helper's map at +0x3D0 and computed by the function at +0x3126E30 on first use.

evidence.says: hash lookup by entity in the table at +0x3CC/+0x3D0; on a miss calls +0x3126E30 and inserts the float
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 7 places, most of them (about 16 000 calls each) inside the function at +0x371F520
